sources.quote: We are actively working to replace all placeholder AI art before launch. While we aim for a fully human-crafted experience, a few minor assets may still remain at release. (See the credits menu for full attributions.)

Interested in playing but I'm more interested if the AI generated placeholders will be removed.
Violet View Profile View Posts Sep 20 @ 8:09pm Report this post Subscribing and commenting in hopes of a response. Store page says AI placeholders to be removed at launch. Did this happen? Will this happen? What is the timeline if so? #1
Zelrune View Profile View Posts Sep 20 @ 10:36pm Report this post It's been five days since launch and the AI placeholder wasn't removed, dev might not have gotten to it yet but I'm hoping it's soonish. #2
casualhuman View Profile View Posts [developer] Sep 21 @ 1:20am Report this post Our efforts right now are focused on fixing bugs and improving the experience. Even if we removed all the AI art, AI localization will stay for a simple reason, we can't ensure at 100% that localization companies aren't using AI. As an (almost) solo dev, I can't afford to hire a company to do something I can do, just so it looks better on paper. This game only uses AI for a few wallpapers and a few door icons, even if they were recreated by hand, they would look pretty much the same, because that's the iconography I wanted to achieve, as an artist myself, for the included cultures. We will do it if we have free time, but in all honesty it's not our priority atm. If you don't feel good about AI usage at all, I would advise you to not buy this game. #3
awarlock View Profile View Posts Sep 21 @ 10:38am Report this post Great game!! I don't care whether AI was used or not to create some things. Glad to purchase and play!! Ready for more!! #4
Zelrune View Profile View Posts Oct 2 @ 10:46pm Report this post Any update to this? #5
Abduxuel View Profile View Posts Oct 6 @ 7:34am Report this post I just finished the game and I LOVED IT! Didn't even notice if there was AI to be honest. Thank you so much for this game :) Please make more lol #6
